rules.note: Electronic copy of your passport with the online application. All documents must be PDF.
Not listed in the official requirements.
Final transcripts and graduation statements are required for all previous university studies.
Official electronic transcripts explaining the grading system. Non-English or non-Arabic ones need an official translation. Send originals on enrolment if admitted on copies.
Current CV covering qualifications, experience, publications, research projects, honours and conference presentations.
Personal statement of 300 to 500 words. Incomplete or too-short statements are not accepted. Requirements can vary by programme.
Two letters, one from an academic referee. Some health and life sciences programmes ask for two or three. You enter referee details in the online application.
IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL 79 (some programmes differ). Scores no more than two years old. Exemptions are possible; see HBKU admissions.
GRE or GMAT is not required for master's. For PhD it is required in Sustainable Energy and Sustainable Environment, and optional in some other science programmes.
Required by the College of Islamic Studies (1,000 to 2,000 words, max 5 pages) and the PhD in Humanities and Social Sciences (1,000 to 2,000 words). Not listed for science colleges.
Required only by the College of Islamic Studies: 15 to 20 pages of academic writing, properly cited, in English and/or Arabic.
